image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on dark grey gravel. The butterfly's wings are held upright and closed, displaying the ventral surface which is light brown/tan with darker brown patches and distinct small black eyespots (ocelli) with white centers. The body is fuzzy and brown, and one clubbed antenna is clearly visible extending to the left. The legs are thin and gripping the rough texture of the stones.
